$comment: Sophira authoritative environment-variable manifest (2026-10-06). Single source of truth: src/lib/env.ts (runtime validation), scripts/gen-env-example.mjs (.env.example generation), scripts/verify-deployment.mjs --env-only (deploy checks), and tests/run.ts (sync assertions) all read THIS file. Never put real secrets here or in .env.example. required: production = must be set for a production deployment; optional = feature degrades honestly when absent; native-release = only required for native/mobile release builds (GitHub Actions); live-tests = only required when RUN_LIVE_TESTS=true; internal = set by repo scripts, never user config.

sections.title: AI provider - FREE-FIRST, ZERO BILLING BY DEFAULT
Native / mobile release (GitHub Actions only - never Vercel)

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
variables.note: Supabase Project Settings -> API. Auto-provisioned by the Vercel Supabase Integration if installed.

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
variables.note: Auto-provisioned by the Vercel Supabase Integration if installed.

variables.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
variables.note: SERVER ONLY - never browser-visible. Auto-provisioned by the Vercel Supabase Integration if installed.

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL
variables.note: Public base URL used in invite links. Set to the production URL for Production, leave the localhost default for local dev. Vercel: also consider System Environment Variable auto-population.

variables.name: AI_PROVIDER
variables.note: selfhost | local | gemini | openai | auto (default auto = selfhost first, then free-tier Gemini, then paid OpenAI only if explicitly allowed). Self-hosted AI is the default path and needs no key.

variables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
variables.note: PREFERRED free-tier provider (server-side only). Get one at aistudio.google.com. With this set and ALLOW_PAID_AI=false, Sophira never spends money.

variables.name: GEMINI_MODEL
variables.note: Gemini model id.

variables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
variables.note: OPTIONAL paid fallback. INERT while ALLOW_PAID_AI=false and MONTHLY_AI_BUDGET_USD=0 - no paid request can ever be sent.

variables.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL
variables.note: OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. a proxy). Only used when paid AI is allowed.

variables.name: SOPHIRA_MODEL
variables.note: OpenAI model id used when paid AI is allowed.

variables.name: ALLOW_PAID_AI
variables.note: SAFEGUARD: keep false to guarantee zero AI billing. true = allow the OpenAI fallback.

variables.name: MONTHLY_AI_BUDGET_USD
variables.note: SAFEGUARD: hard monthly cap in USD for paid AI. 0 = paid AI can never spend.

variables.name: SEARCH_PROVIDER
variables.note: Without a key, the research workflow reports honestly and never fabricates sources.

variables.name: SEARCH_API_KEY
variables.note: Brave/Tavily key for verified web research.

variables.name: SEARCH_BASE_URL
variables.note: Required only when SEARCH_PROVIDER=custom (Brave-compatible endpoint).

variables.name: SOPHIRA_LOCAL_FIRST
variables.note: DEV ONLY: local-first mode. Impossible in production (middleware refuses when NODE_ENV=production).

variables.name: SOPHIRA_OFFLINE_ONLY
variables.note: Release designation: an offline-only release uses local AI only; the release gate then requires green local-AI evidence instead of remote keys.

variables.name: SOPHIRA_QUIET
variables.note: Set by repo scripts to suppress native CLI notes. Not user configuration.

variables.name: SOPHIRA_NATIVE_RELEASE
variables.note: Set by npm run android:build / desktop:build to switch native-url resolution to release mode. Not user configuration.

variables.name: SOPHIRA_APP_URL
variables.note: REQUIRED for native/mobile RELEASE builds: the deployed app URL the native shell loads. Validated: must be a real https URL, not a placeholder. Not needed for Vercel web deploys.

variables.name: SOPHIRA_DEV_URL
variables.note: Native DEV builds: overrides the dev server URL (defaults to NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL).

variables.name: ANDROID_KEYSTORE_FILE
variables.note: Android release signing - GitHub Actions secret/path only. Never commit keystore files.

variables.name: ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64
variables.note: Base64 keystore uploaded as a GitHub Actions secret for release builds.

variables.name: ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS
variables.note: GitHub Actions secret.

variables.name: ANDROID_STORE_PASSWORD
variables.note: GitHub Actions secret.

variables.name: ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD
variables.note: GitHub Actions secret.

variables.name: RUN_LIVE_TESTS
variables.note: CI/live-gate flag: opt in to tests that call a REAL deployment with REAL credentials.

variables.name: SOPHIRA_LIVE_APP_URL
variables.note: Live-gate target deployment URL.

variables.name: SOPHIRA_TEST_SUPABASE_URL
variables.note: Live tests MUST use a SEPARATE test Supabase project - never the production academic database.

variables.name: SOPHIRA_TEST_ANON_KEY
variables.note: Anon key of the TEST project.

variables.name: SOPHIRA_TEST_EMAIL
variables.note: Test account email in the TEST project.

variables.name: SOPHIRA_TEST_PASSWORD
variables.note: Test account password - CI secret, never in the repo.

variables.name: SOPHIRA_TEST_OTHER_ID
variables.note: Second test account id (cross-user isolation checks).

variables.name: IOS_P12_BASE64
variables.note: iOS signing certificate (GitHub Actions secret, base64).

variables.name: IOS_P12_PASSWORD
variables.note: iOS signing certificate password (GitHub Actions secret).

variables.name: IOS_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_BASE64
variables.note: iOS provisioning profile (GitHub Actions secret, base64).

variables.name: IOS_TEAM_ID
variables.note: Apple development team id (GitHub Actions secret).

variables.name: SUPABASE_TEST_URL
variables.note: GitHub Actions secret: URL of the SEPARATE test Supabase project used by the RLS regression suite (never production).

variables.name: SUPABASE_TEST_ANON_KEY
variables.note: GitHub Actions secret: anon key of the TEST project.

variables.name: SUPABASE_TEST_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
variables.note: GitHub Actions secret: service-role key of the TEST project.

variables.name: LOCAL_LLM_BASE_URL
variables.note: SELF-HOSTED AI (the default path): base URL of an OpenAI-compatible local inference server - Ollama (http://127.0.0.1:11434), llama.cpp server, vLLM, LM Studio. No API key required; nothing leaves your machines. In production, point it at your own inference server over HTTPS (or a private network).

variables.name: LOCAL_LLM_MODEL
variables.note: Model to request from the self-hosted server (ollama pull llama3.1:8b). For image/homework reading use a vision model (e.g. qwen2.5-vl or llava).

variables.name: LOCAL_LLM_API_KEY
variables.note: ONLY if your local inference server requires a bearer token. Usually empty - local servers normally need no key. Never expose to the browser.
